query:
UPDATE transactions
         SET sync_flag = CASE WHEN date < date(?, '-14 days')
                              THEN 'not_seen_at_bank' END
         WHERE account_id = ? AND source = 'manual' AND external_id IS NULL
           AND (sync_flag IS NULL OR sync_flag = 'not_seen_at_bank')
           AND kept_by_household = 0
